result.title: AdapToC: A Unified Framework for Multi-Task Visual Token Communication
result.summary: Pretrained discrete visual tokenizers supply compact latents for synthesis, recognition, and embodied perception, yet wireless token streaming remains fragile. Under fading and noisy pilots, hard cyclic redundancy check (CRC) erasures turn corrupted blocks into missing tokens while frozen decoders amplify edge errors, which can collapse unequal error protection (UEP) into a binary choice between strong coding and omission under severe fading. Soft bit posteriors break this collapse. We present AdapToC, a single-pass transceiver that restores multi-tier rate-distortion tradeoffs without altering tokenizer weights or differentiating through pixel decoders. We align codebook geometry to the channel via offline frequency-weighted Pseudo-Gray relabeling and Halton dispersion to contract bit and burst errors with zero overhead. Because soft recovery pulls intermediate rates onto the three-tier convex hull, our unit-gated AdaLN sender schedules protection tiers across channel budgets, while our pilot-calibrated receiver feeds factorized codebook posteriors into a ConvNeXt-attention restorer with CRC bypass. We co-train AdapToC solely in latent space via counterfactual utility estimation and codebook cross-entropy regularization. On identical VQGAN-f16 tokens, AdapToC outperforms TONIC and adaptive TokenCom+AMC, cuts multi-SNR Rayleigh LPIPS from 0.6551 to 0.3312 within the frozen-tokenizer PSNR ceiling, and saves 43.8% Rician-K6 symbols at matched quality. Our single-pass restorer runs 8.3x faster than iterative resampling, raises accuracy while accelerating decoder-free recognition 20.6x, and improves fidelity plug-and-play across TiTok, VAR, and zero-shot NuPlan.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 AdapToC，一个单次前向的视觉 token 无线传输框架：通过离线 Pseudo-Gray 重标注对齐码本几何、以软比特后验替代硬 CRC 擦除，并用 AdaLN 发送端调度保护层级、ConvNeXt-attention 接收端恢复，在冻结 tokenizer 下取得多档率失真折中。
AI.relevance_reason: 其用码本软后验代替「丢弃或强编码」的二元处理，以及在 latent 空间用反事实效用联合训练、不反传像素解码器的做法，可能可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据不确定性筛选与 latent 训练监督的设计；但属于无线传输场景，迁移价值需较多核查。
